description: Per-crate dev-path decision from DESIGN-TS section 4 and INVENTORY Q4. decision is one of builtin-adapter, c-shim, compile-from-source. Release always uses the original crates through Cargo. Match by cargo package name; names are also tried with - and _ swapped. Unknown crates get decision unknown in reports.

dependencies.name: goport_util
dependencies.notes: Owned project code. JSON, std ports, diagnostics and macros.

dependencies.name: goport_lsproto
dependencies.notes: Owned generated protocol code. Keep shared type identity and re-exports.

dependencies.name: ts_goport
dependencies.notes: The project crate itself (ts_wasm depends on it).

dependencies.name: ts_wasm
dependencies.notes: Owned wasm ABI crate. Later target gate.

dependencies.name: rustc-hash
dependencies.notes: Small hasher plus aliases to std maps. DESIGN-TS section 4 says compile the selected source; INVENTORY Q4 says built-in Fx HashMap. The hash algorithm and iteration order must match where output depends on them.

dependencies.name: rustc_hash
dependencies.notes: Same crate as rustc-hash, underscore spelling.

dependencies.name: indexmap
dependencies.notes: Ordered map and set. Keep insertion order, removal variants, borrowed lookup, Entry and iteration.

dependencies.name: smallvec
dependencies.notes: Inline storage and spill for concrete element and capacity types.

dependencies.name: bumpalo
dependencies.notes: Typed arena allocation. Keep limits, alignment and no implicit drops. INVENTORY Q4: built-in leaked arena.

dependencies.name: memchr
dependencies.notes: Exact byte search over buffers and indices. DESIGN-TS: cached shim plus lust iterator wrappers. INVENTORY Q4: built-in over C memchr/memmem.

dependencies.name: xxhash-rust
dependencies.notes: xxh3_64, xxh3_128 and streaming state. Keep digest bytes; carry 128-bit results in two halves at the boundary.

dependencies.name: xxhash_rust
dependencies.notes: Same crate as xxhash-rust, underscore spelling.

dependencies.name: flate2
dependencies.notes: Gzip encode and decode. Stream state can be opaque. INVENTORY Q4: gzip API over zlib.

dependencies.name: jiff
dependencies.notes: Local time zone for diagnostic timestamps. INVENTORY Q4: built-in over localtime_r.

dependencies.name: rustix
dependencies.notes: Signals, pipes, fstat, termios, events, polling and processes. Keep ownership and errno.

dependencies.name: signal-hook
dependencies.notes: Signal registration and flags. Handlers cannot call lust closures directly.

dependencies.name: signal_hook
dependencies.notes: Same crate as signal-hook, underscore spelling.

dependencies.name: tikv-jemallocator
dependencies.notes: Adapter in library/deps: the Jemalloc unit struct for #[global_allocator] statics. Dev keeps the lust runtime allocator; allocation strategy does not change output. The unsafe GlobalAlloc surface is not in the adapter.

dependencies.name: tikv-jemalloc-ctl
dependencies.notes: Typed arena and thread controls. Do not substitute a no-op.

dependencies.name: nix
dependencies.notes: Linux process and signal operations, fanotify, kqueue, prctl.

dependencies.name: miow
dependencies.notes: Windows named pipes. Later target gate; absent on Linux.

dependencies.name: same-file
dependencies.notes: Windows file identity. Later target gate.

dependencies.name: same_file
dependencies.notes: Same crate as same-file, underscore spelling.

dependencies.name: num-bigint
dependencies.notes: Small BigInt for literal parse and print. DESIGN-TS: opaque BigInt shim plus the used methods.

dependencies.name: num_bigint
dependencies.notes: Same crate as num-bigint, underscore spelling.

dependencies.name: num-traits
dependencies.notes: Number traits used by the BigInt layer and the project number wrapper.

dependencies.name: num_traits
dependencies.notes: Same crate as num-traits, underscore spelling.

dependencies.name: ryu-js
dependencies.notes: Exact JS number formatting. Must match byte for byte; a generic float formatter is not a replacement. INVENTORY Q4 also calls this a built-in C port.

dependencies.name: ryu_js
dependencies.notes: Same crate as ryu-js, underscore spelling.

dependencies.name: unicode-normalization
dependencies.notes: Buffer-based NFC normalization for macOS paths and cross-platform tests.

dependencies.name: unicode_normalization
dependencies.notes: Same crate as unicode-normalization, underscore spelling.

dependencies.name: name-to-handle-at
dependencies.notes: Linux watcher file handles.

dependencies.name: name_to_handle_at
dependencies.notes: Same crate as name-to-handle-at, underscore spelling.

dependencies.name: notify
dependencies.notes: macOS and Windows watcher. Events cross as explicit records.

dependencies.name: lzma-rust2
dependencies.notes: Build-time use runs with Cargo in preparation. Add a decode shim for wasm.

dependencies.name: lzma_rust2
dependencies.notes: Same crate as lzma-rust2, underscore spelling.

dependencies.name: libc
dependencies.notes: Raw libc bindings. Covered by the platform shim layer.

dependencies.name: hashbrown
dependencies.notes: Raw table under indexmap and std maps. Not compiled from source; the adapter reproduces needed behavior.

dependencies.name: equivalent
dependencies.notes: Small trait crate used by indexmap. Pure and safe; can compile after traits.

dependencies.name: miniz_oxide
dependencies.notes: Part of flate2. Mostly safe but grouped with the gzip shim.
